columns.name: survey_wave
columns.meaning: Survey wave, not a longitudinal follow-up identifier.

columns.name: household_id
columns.meaning: Source hhid normalized with the existing wave-specific minimum width; raw hhid retained.

columns.name: person_id
columns.meaning: Source persid normalized with the existing wave-specific minimum width; raw persid retained.

columns.name: source_id
columns.meaning: Local immutable source identity; not cses_meta.dataset_id.

columns.name: source_row_number
columns.meaning: One-based row position in the original Stata member.

columns.name: source_archive
columns.meaning: Original archive path relative to the repository.

columns.name: source_member_chain
columns.meaning: Ordered archive-member chain, including nested ZIP members.

columns.name: source_sha256
columns.meaning: SHA-256 of the original Stata member bytes.

columns.name: raw_record
columns.meaning: All native fields with original case, values and nulls; numeric sentinels are unchanged.

columns.name: hh_link_matched
columns.meaning: Household-wave key occurs in the checked HH snapshot.

columns.name: hl_link_status
columns.meaning: matched, person_not_in_roster, or household_conflict against the checked HL snapshot.

columns.name: roster_household_id
columns.meaning: HL household ID for the same wave/person; null if the person is absent.

columns.name: questionnaire_evidence_status
columns.meaning: Local form availability only; not question-specific semantic approval.

columns.name: harmonization_status
columns.meaning: Always native_codes_not_harmonized in this source-layer table.

policy: Retain every source row, including unmatched people; do not synthesize records for roster-only people.
Do not attach population characteristics or weights to unmatched people through household-only matching.
Do not replace native codes, infer cross-wave questions, transfer 2016 wording to 2017, or assume zero for absence.
This version requires zero extended Stata missing codes; a new explicit representation is required if they appear.
New source datasets, variable metadata, output registry, release and load-run records are required before publication.
The preflight does not perform DDL, INSERT, COPY, UPDATE or DELETE and does not authorize a named release.
